present_headers.description: Restricts resources (such as JavaScript, CSS, Images) that the browser is allowed to load.
Protects users against clickjacking attacks by controlling whether the site can be framed.
Prevents the browser from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared content-type.

verbose_headers.description: Exposes server configuration details which could assist reconnaissance.
verbose_headers.recommendation: Remove the 'Server' header or sanitize its value in the server configuration.

issues.description: Cookie lacks the 'Secure' flag, allowing it to be transmitted in cleartext over unencrypted HTTP.
issues.recommendation: Configure the application or server to append '; Secure' to the Set-Cookie directive.

issues.description: Cookie does not explicitly define a 'SameSite' attribute, relying on default browser behavior.
issues.recommendation: Set the 'SameSite' attribute to 'Lax' or 'Strict' to prevent Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).
